reviews.title: Cute, Comfy, and Crazy Good for the price
reviews.comment: I got these on a deal and I’m SO happy with them! Not only are they SUPER cute, they’re lightweight, comfortable, and they sound good! The microphone is clear as well. These have been great for gaming and even watching videos and they are amazing for the price. They feel really light on my head but do a great job blocking out background noise. I can wear them comfortably with my glasses as well. Love these, out of all the different gaming headphones I’ve tried in the $75-250 range these have been my absolute favorite ones!
reviews.author: Jimstone Reviews

reviews.title: Love these
reviews.comment: I’ve been using these headphones for a bit now, and I honestly love them so far. One thing that surprised me right away was that I didn’t need a headphone splitter. My computer case doesn’t have a combined audio/mic jack, so I usually have to buy extra adapters, but with these headphones everything worked perfectly right out of the box. Both the sound and mic were recognized without any issues, which was a huge plus for me. The microphone quality has also been great. People I’ve talked to have said my voice sounds really clear on their end ((almost too crisp lol.) They’ve even joked that they can hear everything. As for audio quality, everything sounds clear and balanced on my computer. Whether it’s videos, music, or for gaming, the sound comes through nicely and feels clean rather than muffled. Overall, I’m really happy with these headphones so far. They were easy to set up, work well with my PC, and deliver clear sound and mic quality, which is exactly what I was looking for.
reviews.author: Natalia

reviews.title: Only headphones Id say are worth the price
reviews.comment: Amazing headphones! I love them! I wear them for hours and barely can tell theyre there. By far the most Ive ever spent on headphones, but it was so worth it! The detachable microphone is just a nice quality of life thing, on top of the toggle-able on/off button for said microphone. My friends say this microphone is also good quality on voice chat, so no need to worry if detachable means worse! The audio quality is amazing too, for the record, I almost forgot to mention that because Im so used to it just being amazing lol They also came with a usb-c adapter which added so much length to the cord! By far, theyre just worth it and amazing headphones!
reviews.author: Shannon Congdon

reviews.title: Great headphones
reviews.comment: I use these headphones every.single.day. Absolutely love them. They have held up super well over time and for the most part still feel brand new. They are unbelievably comfortable and wearing them for long periods doesn’t causes a headache like other brands I have tried. A super reliable headset. I use them for my Xbox controller and have no chord fraying issues. The cord is stiff enough it still has some of the original folds still on it lol. No fraying at the base and the jack has help up very well.
reviews.author: Claire

reviews.title: Great headset
reviews.comment: Really cute, soft, and comfortable. Good sound and mic quality is good, definitely much better than my old one (steelseries). Its much clearer and doesnt echo.
